notes.title: Server Update + The Art of Moon Hunters now available
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It's Alexandra from Kitfox with a Moon Hunters update. I'm sad to announce that Unity cut off the service for their networking implementation which means that the Moon Hunters online servers have been cut off effective July 7th. We unfortunately do not have the resources to re-implement it as it would take significant time and resources to rebuild the game for Unity's requirements. This means that the game is now only local co-op, with the possibility of playing online via Steam Remote Play. For instructions and FAQ for how to use Steam Remote Play, [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0689-74B8-92AC-10F2]click here.[/url]

We understand this is disappointing to many of you who loved Moon Hunters for it's online co-op experience. Kitfox was only just a studio of 6 when we were building an online multiplayer game for the first time. It was a huge challenge for us, and we are just as saddened to see that it's something we are unable to preserve in it's original form. We are thankful there is still a way to access online co-op but we know it's not the same.

We have updated our storefront information to reflect the changes to the game and we encourage anyone who bought the game recently and wanted to use online co-op to please consider trying Steam Remote Play or request a refund. Thank you to everyone for understanding and please continue to enjoy this special game.

[h3]The Art of Moon Hunters[/h3]

In some happier news, we have made The Art of Moon Hunters available for the first-time ever on Steam. Back in the day when Moon Hunters came out, there wasn't a way for us to upload art books as DLC, but now we can, so we did! It's written from the perspective of an archaeologist delving into the legends of an ancient world. It includes concept art that have never been published anywhere else. You can also pick up the book for an introductory for 10% off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3765650/Moon_Hunters_Art_Book/

Till next time.

-Alexandra

notes.title: Announcing: Lucifer Within Us!
notes.content:
Last night, we revealed our newest title: Lucifer Within Us, from the creator of the Shrouded Isle.

As a digital exorcist in Lucifer Within Us, you’re asked to solve murders, purify the possessed, and purge their daemons. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/717560/Lucifer_Within_Us/]Watch the trailer and add it to your wishlist now![/url]

[h1]Investigate timelines.[/h1]
Question your suspects. Watch their movements and testimonies closely, as the reconstruction may be based on lies. Use contradictions and clues to form your own hypothesis. Who is lying and why? Who is possessed? You must decide what is the truth for yourself, based on the evidence presented.

[h1]Real mystery-solving.[/h1]
No hidden plot twists, no QTEs, no random puzzles or mini-games, just you and the information. Don’t just act like a detective -- BE a detective. Finding the murderer will require true understanding of the case, not just following the story.

[h1]Banish daemonic A.I.[/h1]
Enter the minds of citizens to gain insight into what they don’t want you to know. Dig through their subconscious and accuse the guilty in order to cast out their daemons, for the good of the Inquisition. Any damage done to a citizen’s psyche as a result of quarantine, exorcism, or rehabilitation is a consequence of their own immorality.

[h1]Expose the False Utopia.[/h1]
Through centuries of indoctrination, humanity is taught to think pure thoughts and speak true words, untainted by falsehoods and delusions. Yet beneath this facade of purity, you find dark desires stir deep within people’s hearts, yearning for release. 

If you want to keep tabs on the game's development, maybe check [url=http://discord.gg/kitfoxgames]out our Discord and the Lucifer Within Us channel[/url], where the devs sometimes hang out with other fans of digital exorcism.

Ain Soph's blessings,
Tanya and the Kitfox team

notes.title: A Stuttering Fix?
notes.content:
Hey Hunters!

A few of you have noticed Moon Hunters has been getting some frequent updates lately. We think we’ve [i]finally[/i] [b]finally[/b] FINALLY found the thing behind most of the lag and stuttering reports that have been sprinkling the forums. So please play the game and let us know if there’s anything up with it! There should also be major performance improvements when multiple enemies are present.

Keep in mind you still need a pretty good system to run Moon Hunters. There are a few cases in which changes made the experience better for many players but potentially worse for others - we're trying to identify the cases that are left and fix them, along with other lingering known issues.

If you find any problems as you play, don’t be afraid to poke us (gently!!) in the forums. If it’s about stuttering, please include these details when you report it:
[list]
[*] Is it a pure low framerate problem? Or does the game "freeze" a little bit from time to time? If it’s a freeze, is it a short or a long freeze?
[*] How frequent is it? Every half second? Every 5 seconds?
[*] Is the in-game time during the night or during the day?
[*] Does it happen more in a specific biome (ex: forest)?
[*] If you can do a quick test, once it starts stuttering, can you try to open the Pause menu for a few seconds and close it? Does it make a difference?
[/list]

That’s all from us for now! We’re buckling down on our next game announcement and of course the Nintendo Switch version of Moon Hunters coming soon. 

Keep an eye out on our [url=twitter.com/kitfoxgames]Twitter[/url], [url=facebook.com/kitfoxgames]Facebook[/url], or [url=https://discord.gg/NPvSakt]Discord[/url] for the latest news! 

Cheers,
Victoria and the Kitfox team

notes.title: You're invited to the Eternal Echoes beta!
notes.content:
Want to try out the new (free!) Moon Hunters expansion coming out in a couple of weeks?

You can! It's slightly dangerous, but for the intrepid among you... take a deep breath...

Ready? If you own Moon Hunters, and are eager to see the content no matter the costs, follow these steps:

[olist]
[*]Be warned it has some bugs (especially online)! It's a beta!
[*]Right-click the entry for Moon Hunters in your Steam Library. Choose Properties.
[*]Click on the Betas tab. Enter access code "privateBetaOn". Click Check Code. Then "privatebeta" branch should appear. Choose it!
[*] You should now be able to close the Properties window and see the game is updating, and says "Moon Hunters [privatebeta]" in the list.
[*]When you see an error or glitch in the game, please press B on your keyboard and make sure to change the description of the bug to be descriptive. More info is better! It will automatically send your report to us and we'll fix it asap.
[*]If you have long-form feedback to give, email tanya@kitfoxgames.com and the team will improve the game with it. :)
[/olist]

We don't recommend switching back and forth between Eternal Echoes and 'vanilla' Moon Hunters, but you technically can do it. When you run the beta for the first time, it will create a backup folder with your current savefiles and progress files. This folder will also be cloud-saved automatically. The folder is called backup_ and is located in your cloud-save folder (in Windows usually it's: C:\Users\\AppData\Roaming\MoonHunters\SaveData). Keep this backup folder safe. 

To restore the state of the game to when the backup was done, follow these steps:
[list]
[*]Start Moon Hunters
[*]Alt Tab out of the game
[*]Replace the contents of the main save folder by the contents of the backup folder
[*]Alt Tab back to Moon Hunter and close the game.
[/list]
After doing this your savefiles are restored to a pre-expansion state.

Thanks in advance, you brave beta hunters!
Tanya & the Kitfox team

notes.title: Online multiplayer is released: v1.1.0!
notes.content:
Thanks for all of your support and patience. Online beta lasted about 4 months longer than we first thought it would, but here we are now, with an online multiplayer mode that actually works and no known desynch issues. Hooray!

Of course there are always a few things left to improve and fix, but it's well worth the effort for excellent players like yourselves.

Full patch notes:

* Online mode is now out of Beta!
* Dialogue cursors online are in the correct position.
* Initial dialogue is now shown online too.
* Druid totem shows correctly when dying as a dog.
* The sky in adventure maps looks much better now.
* Buttons in the Constellation Sky are now clickable.
* World Map locations are now clickable.
* The Gilgamesh encounter no longer sometimes cuts off your mountain path.
* Constellations should no longer appear to unlock multiple times.
* Character classes, costumes, and speaking with animals or ghosts should no longer appear to unlock multiple times.

We have some exciting news coming in the next few weeks, so stay tuned!
Tanya & the Kitfox team

notes.title: New patch today (1.0.2547) - keybindings + new enemy!
notes.content:
First, a warm greeting to all of our new players who just picked up the game in last week's sale, or who heard about our launch on PlayStation 4. Welcome welcome! We hope you enjoy it here in Issaria.

Today's patch has been long in coming, much longer than we had hoped, but keybindings are one of the trickiest things in a 1-4 player game with various supported control schemes. And now [b]keybindings finally work properly[/b]! There were multiple cascading issues with whether to store the keybinds per controller or per profile or per player slot (and in local co-op vs online). But those seem mostly cleaned up now, so we can focus on smaller, more satisfying bugfixes. Thank you for your patience!

Today's patch also introduces [b]a new enemy, the Quarrier Queen[/b]! She's a tougher beetle in the desert, apt to shoot three sun orbs.

There's also lots [b]more villagers talking trash[/b] about (OK fine they mostly adore) your past heroes, in their hometowns during future playthroughs.

Full [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/320040/discussions/0/405694115199940892/]patch notes[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/320040/discussions/0/405694115199941303/]known issues[/url] are available in the forums!

Thank you for being the best fans, 
Tanya & the Kitfox team

notes.title: Online play improved & a new familiar!
notes.content:
With dialogue, shop, and interface issues 99.999% solved in patch 1.0.2482, we're very very close to removing that "beta" tag from online mode. Unfortunately, we had to hold back Online keybinding until Henk has finished restructuring the way controllers and character login works, which we're hoping to happen very soon.

By way of apology, we've added the Mulberry Toad familiar!

Here's the full patch notes:
* (Online) Several fixes for getting stuck in dialogues or upgrade shop, especially in limited/slow network conditions.
* Songweavers should check the Mangroves for a new loyal friend - the Mulberry Toad familiar.
* Fixed an issue with the Witch’s stab attack on non-default costumes.
* Sun cult enemies are now affected by the Druid’s vines.
* Hometown selection is now a proper vote.
* Lots of optimizations! The game should run more smoothly on most machines.
* The Rat is now the Fox constellation, for you Cunning heroes out there. Old legends might still call you The Rat though, if they were generated before this patch.
* Translation into all 6 non-English languages, for the post-launch encounters and other text.
* Better fade-out and fade-in transitions between scenes.
* More and better sound-effects for various enemies, including Mardokh.

Thank you!
Tanya & the Kitfox crew

notes.title: INDIEBOX! +New encounters, visitors, and PS4 launch date!
notes.content:
EDIT: [url=https://www.theindiebox.com/moon-hunters/]We're the June IndieBox![/url] Check it out to pick up unique collector's edition goodies (details to be announced).

Plus, patch 1.0.2382 went live today. It includes some cutscene changes, and a handful of new encounters (some of which still need translation, sorry, please be patient -- hopefully we can patch the translations in soon)... including Gilgamesh and Utnapishtim, from the Epic of Gilgamesh. Henk also implemented some interesting improvements to the Ritualist, who was feeling a bit stale.

We've also announced [url=http://blog.us.playstation.com/2016/05/27/moon-hunters-launches-on-ps4-july-12-2016/]through the PlayStation blog[/url] that [b]Moon Hunters is coming to PlayStation 4 on July 12th[/b]! So we might have smaller patches for a little while as we focus on that, though obviously we are still hoping to bring the Online out of beta as soon as possible.

Finally, Kitfox turns 3 years old today! Three years ago, we came together and decided to make interesting worlds that are different every time... first we made [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/305640/]Shattered Planet[/url], then Moon Hunters, and.. thank you for making that possible.

And for you detail-orienteds, here's the full patch notes!

[h1]June 1 - 1.0.2382[/h1]
* Revised the opening cutscene at the game’s start, to more accurately reflect the game’s content and themes.
* French language: All cutscenes feature new French voice!
* Six new encounters can be found in the wild, with one new cave and three all-new characters, including wrestling with Gilgamesh himself.
* Your camp can be visited by six more characters as a follow-up to encounters -- including finally using that old Anzu feather.
* Three new camp activity random encounters have been added (one each to Hunting, Keeping Watch, Stargazing).
* The cost of tier 2 and 3 upgrades has been reduced from 100 / 200 to 75 / 150.
* The Ritualist’s accumulates dark orbs while you aren’t shooting, letting you fire off a whole volley of orbs quickly! When out of orbs, her firing rate reduces significantly.
* The Ritualist has a new upgrade, Dark Reservoir, which increase the number of orbs that can be held.
* Ingredient pickups no longer drop if they’ve already been unlocked.
* The environment music resumes after boss music ends.
* Fixed an issue where visual damage effects from fire weren’t appearing in the right place.
* (Online) Players should no longer get moved from their positions when entering / leaving caves.
* (Online) Enemy attacks from the boar and vulture are applied more consistently.
* (Online) Fixed an issue where one of Humbaba’s attacks wasn’t being applied for remote players.
* (Online) Kills / deaths are attributed to the right players.
* (Online) The spirit guardian’s bomb attack applies properly to remote players.
* (Online) The Witch’s Blood Charge skill properly shows its visual effect online.
* (Online) Fixed an issue where ingredients picked up during a playthrough wouldn’t show as unlocked for remote players.

Have fun!
Tanya & the Kitfox team

We've also announced [url=http://blog.us.playstation.com/2016/05/27/moon-hunters-launches-on-ps4-july-12-2016/]through the PlayStation blog[/url] that [b]Moon Hunters is coming to PlayStation 4 on July 12th[/b]! So we might have smaller patches for a little while as we focus on that, though obviously we are still hoping to bring the Online out of beta as soon as possible.

Finally, Kitfox turns 3 years old today! Three years ago, we came together and decided to make interesting worlds that are different every time... first we made [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/305640/]Shattered Planet[/url], then Moon Hunters, and.. thank you for making that possible.

And for you detail-orienteds, here's the full patch notes!

[h1]June 1 - 1.0.2382[/h1]
* Revised the opening cutscene at the game’s start, to more accurately reflect the game’s content and themes.
* French language: All cutscenes feature new French voice!
* Six new encounters can be found in the wild, with one new cave and three all-new characters, including wrestling with Gilgamesh himself.
* Your camp can be visited by six more characters as a follow-up to encounters -- including finally using that old Anzu feather.
* Three new camp activity random encounters have been added (one each to Hunting, Keeping Watch, Stargazing).
* The cost of tier 2 and 3 upgrades has been reduced from 100 / 200 to 75 / 150.
* The Ritualist’s accumulates dark orbs while you aren’t shooting, letting you fire off a whole volley of orbs quickly! When out of orbs, her firing rate reduces significantly.
* The Ritualist has a new upgrade, Dark Reservoir, which increase the number of orbs that can be held.
* Ingredient pickups no longer drop if they’ve already been unlocked.
* The environment music resumes after boss music ends.
* Fixed an issue where visual damage effects from fire weren’t appearing in the right place.
* (Online) Players should no longer get moved from their positions when entering / leaving caves.
* (Online) Enemy attacks from the boar and vulture are applied more consistently.
* (Online) Fixed an issue where one of Humbaba’s attacks wasn’t being applied for remote players.
* (Online) Kills / deaths are attributed to the right players.
* (Online) The spirit guardian’s bomb attack applies properly to remote players.
* (Online) The Witch’s Blood Charge skill properly shows its visual effect online.
* (Online) Fixed an issue where ingredients picked up during a playthrough wouldn’t show as unlocked for remote players.

Have fun!
Tanya & the Kitfox team

notes.title: Featured on PBS! + Update 1.0.2297 available
notes.content:
Hey Moon Hunters!

If you're curious what it felt like in the weeks and months leading up to Moon Hunters launch, you can [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R2meXJxUXCY]watch "Qulture" and learn about indie games in Montreal, featuring Kitfox[/url]! It includes footage from our team meetings, launch party, and more.

And in the 10 short days since the last patch, we've fixed a whole host of issues, especially online. Here's the major changes (not counting little things like typos, etc):

* (Online) IP entering has been replaced with a 4-number Lobby code.
* (Online) Occasional failure to close the shop panel doesn’t happen anymore.
* (Online) Even less disconnects than before.
* (Online) Fixed an issue where some enemies would only be present on the client.
* (Online) Fixed an issue where some projectiles (such as the tornado) would last forever in camp.
* (Online) Loading screen doesn’t get players stuck anymore.
* (Online) Arenas no longer occasionally double up the enemies.
* (Online) End-of-game character myths and constellations match on all clients.
* (Online) Fixed a couple of cases where dialogues could be accidentally skipped without voting, leaving the other players behind.
* (Online) Fixed an issue where player could be revived while alive, causing visual glitches the next time they died.
* Made it clearer when players are stunned by enemy attacks.
* Boars have more aggressive behaviour!
* Charging enemies can no longer be stunned while charging.
* Saved games more reliably generate the same adventure map on successive loads.
* Of interest to those who can speak with spirits, the “Blade of Chance” encounter location(s) has been revealed on the world map. You can also now talk with the Blade of Chance, after restoring her regalia.
* Mardokh will no longer sometimes spawn twice.
* In 4-player games, some players will never be kicked out of the final battle with Mardokh.
* Fixed an issue that let players cook multiple times in camp.
* Some players who could not redeem their Black Cat or Phoenix familiars can now do so.

I've been writing a few new encounters, but we're waiting on a few elements before they can go live.. plus we're still prioritizing getting Online out of beta. 

If you want to tell us what you think we should add or fix next, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/320040/discussions/0/385428458162793610/]chime in on the forums[/url]! We'd love to hear more discussion of ideas.

Let's keep hunting the moon!
Tanya & the Kitfox team

notes.title: Today's Patch Improves the Spellblade, Sun Cultist, and Online Play!
notes.content:
We went to PAX, which disrupted our schedules a bit, but was really fun. Thanks to everyone who came by the booth. You can see a few pictures on [url=https://www.facebook.com/kitfoxgames]our Facebook page here[/url]!

We also just posted up 1.0.2232, which includes:

[list]
[*] A boost to Spellblades: a heavier 1-2-3 combo attack, with the third attack [i]always[/i] creating a tornado
[*] A boost to Sun Cultists: better knockback on the chakram swipe, and easier-to-use meteor.
[*] The Phoenix familiar, for fans who purchased it online during PAX, or came by the PAX booth.
[*] Various online fixes (opals, health bars, breakables, bugs, etc)
[*] The Shieldo enemy is much more fun to fight now, with improved behaviour and a vulnerable state.
[/list]

To see the full patch-notes, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/320040/discussions/0/405694115199940892/]visit the forums[/url]!

We apologize for those of you who have been waiting eagerly for this patch. We intend to continue patching on our biweekly schedule (meaning we hope to patch again next week).

Thanks for your support!
Tanya & the Kitfox team

notes.title: Week 2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We just put up patch 1.0.2093, which includes:

* (Online) Added support for Steam Invite. Look in the bottom right after pressing Host Game.
* Improved load times and memory usage in several places.
* Baba Yaga can now be found on the world map, and will always appear in the same adventure map as her cat Bayun.
* The mouse cursor hides itself when not being used.
* Non-native screen resolutions can now be used in fullscreen.
* The Songweaver’s ability panel now shows the correct buttons when using a gamepad.
* The Witch’s stab attack has more reliable collision checking.
* The Ritualist's dash is much nicer-looking now.
* Unlockable palettes are now selectable with gamepad and mouse in both online and offline play.
* Health pickups now heal players even when shielded / evading.
* The recipe count now shows the correct number of recipes unlocked.
* The proper text for hero names is displayed in places it wasn’t shown before.
* (Online) Dialogue confirmation moves forward properly in cases where it was occasionally getting stuck.
* (Online) The end-of-adventure award screen and shop screen can no longer become stuck if one player cancels while the other confirms.
* (Online) The mouse can now be used even when a gamepad is assigned.

Next week: Mac & Linux!

We're also hoping to start looking at improvements like a few more events, characters, etc. Let us know in the forums if you have a suggestion for what you want to see most.

Thanks!
Tanya & the Kitfox team

notes.title: Week 1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey there moon hunters! We've patched a few times over the last week, and although we still have a bunch of issues we're hoping to tackle next week, I thought I'd catch you up on what we fixed.

If you're interested in keeping tabs on the timing & content of each and every patch, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/320040/discussions/0/405694115199940892/]check the forum thread on Patch Notes[/url] but here's all of it mushed together for your convenience:

MAJOR
* The framerate is now limited to the current monitor refresh rate.

GAMEPLAY
* Fixed the Songweaver sometimes not regaining stamina while running.
* Fixed the Songweaver’s run speed buff carrying over between areas.
* Fixed the Spellblade’s Shockwave animation triggering when it shouldn’t.
* Fixed several issues with dialogue being displayed incorrectly.
* Fixed an issue that prevented Apricot events from appearing.
* The final boss can no longer be damaged while spawning.
* Fixed an issue where players were getting stuck in certain caves when playing online.

ONLINE
* Fixed players sometimes getting stuck at the hometown selection screen.
* Fixed remote players not always being able to hit the final boss when playing online.
* Fixed an online death synchronization issue.
* Fixed remote player totems sometimes moving off-screen.
* Fixed an issue where enemies would sometimes disappear online.
* The pause panel no longer pauses enemies when online.
* Players with different client versions will be asked to update when trying to join.

INTERFACE
* Keybinding settings have been reset to resolve issues some players were having.
* Improved initial loading experience.
* A visual bug with selecting options in the Cooking Panel has been fixed.
* Increased clickable area on the dialogue panel UIs.
* Improved mouse controls in the in-game options menu.
* Fixed some incorrect button icons being shown in the ability panel.
* The host's IP address is now shown in the "host game" menu, as well as an option to hide it.
* The host game menu now links to our "How to play online" guide.

Thank you so much for your patience & support! We'll strive to make the game better and better with your feedback over the next months or (gods willing) years!

notes.title: Thanks for a Great Launch Day!
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who helped spread the word about Moon Hunters yesterday! The game released on Steam, Humble, itch.io, and IndieGameStand!

We've had a few glowing articles published recently, including:

* "[url=http://www.ign.com/articles/2016/03/04/zelda-meets-diablo-in-the-gorgeous-moon-hunters?watch]Zelda Meets Diablo in the Gorgeous Moon Hunters[/url]" by IGN
* "[url=http://indiegames.com/2016/03/let_me_tell_you_a_story_-_the_.html]The Importance of Player Stories in Moon Hunters[/url]" by Indiegames.com
* A "[url=http://wegotthiscovered.com/gaming/moon-hunters-review/]GREAT[/url]" (four-star) rating by WeGotThisCovered 
* And lots more, but you get the idea!

If you have played the game, please leave us a Steam review! It really helps! 

I'm also still sorting through all of your lovely emails and messages, but it's clear most of you have been cheering us on for two years and your support has meant the world to us. We were briefly #22 in the top sellers, beating out Dark Souls III!

This is just the beginning, and we're already planning out what will be in the patches to come every week. Today we hope to put up a couple of fixes for the Options menu and Character Select screen, and next week we're focusing on optimizations.

[h1]How else can I play Moon Hunters?[/h1]
Other than Humble, itch, and IndieGameStand, we were initially planning (and had announced) coming to GOG yesterday. But at the last minute, we decided to delay the GOG build until the Online mode goes out of "beta", to better-suit the nature of GOG. 

Taking everything into account, this is the current release schedule for all of the remaining (confirmed) Moon Hunters platforms:

GOG.com: March 24th (and Online leaves Beta)
Mac & Linux: March 31st
PS4: June-July
PSVita: August-September

We are also considering other platforms, but for now it's one step at a time. Thank you AGAIN for all of your support and patience! <3

Cheers,
Tanya & the Kitfox team

notes.title: Blood Moon Fan Art Contest
notes.content:
With a Super Blood Moon Eclipse coming up on September 27th, we've just got to appease the lunar deities... so we decided to hold a fan art contest!

That means it's time to get creative. Break out those markers, Photoshops, ukeleles, pens, notepads, Play-doh, needlework, and typewriters (or what-have-you) because it's not limited to visual arts. Feel free to work in whatever medium you feel most comfortable in, as long as it involves characters or settings within the Moon Hunters universe. You can check out our [url=http://www.kitfoxgames.com/press/sheet.php?p=moon_hunters]press kit[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCK0wWfg2_bqWOQFFNWp58mw]Youtube channel[/url] for references and inspiration.

Once you're all done, [b]submit your entry via link or file to info@kitfoxgames.com by 11:59 PM EST on September 24th[/b], 2015. 

The prizes include:
[list]
[*]First Place: 4 Steam keys for Moon Hunters (for you and three friends), the opportunity to name a creature, and a pixel art icon commission by our own Mike H
[*]Second Place: 2 Steam keys for Moon Hunters and a pixel art icon commission
[*]Third Place: 2 Steam keys for Moon Hunters
[/list]

All winning keys also gain access to the restricted beta!

And now for the rules:

[list]
[*]The work must be your own. We want you to make it, but feel free to get help from friends or family members (with their permission, of course)
[*]It must involve Moon Hunters characters or settings
[*]You can submit multiple pieces, but sending more doesn't increase your odds of winning
[*]No offensive language or vulgar images in your submissions, please. Stay cool.
[/list]

Once we get the submissions, the staff of Kitfox Games (all 5 of us!) will be casting our votes for our top three picks, which we'll tally up and announce after the end of the contest. The winners will be contacted by the e-mail they used to submit their work, and all of the submissions will be collected on a post here on our blog. And if you send it in time, we might even be able to show it off [b]on our livestream on the 24th[/b]...! :D

So get cracking, and we can't wait to see what you come up with!

<3
Tanya and the Kitfox tribe
